parrafo_1.es: Phelps Land Works es el negocio de Tony en Port St. Lucie. Tritura tocones de cualquier tamaño, remueve árboles completos y despeja terrenos y lotes boscosos para construcción o mantenimiento.
parrafo_1.en: Phelps Land Works is Tony's business in Port St. Lucie. He grinds stumps of any size, removes full trees and clears lots and wooded land for construction or upkeep.

parrafo_2.es: Las reseñas repiten lo mismo: responde rápido, llega a tiempo y cobra un precio justo. Gian tenía tres tocones de hasta 52 pulgadas de diámetro y Tony los dejó sin rastro.
parrafo_2.en: The reviews keep saying the same thing: he responds fast, shows up on time and charges a fair price. Gian had three stumps as large as 52 inches across, and Tony ground them down until nothing was left.

items.quote: Great work. Great price. Someone referred him to me and I will do the same. I had 3 big stumps, as large as 52 inches in diameter but he did a great job grinding them until there was nothing left.

Tony and his guy came on time and were very efficient. I called a total of 6 different companies and all of them wanted to charge me a minimum fee of either $300 or $400. I called Tony and he came out and took care of it for a reasonable price.

Excellent. Professional. And just a great person. Great to deal with, communication and prompt service. Does exactly what he says he is going to do when he says he is going to do it. I don't take that for granted.
Phelps responded quickly to give me a quote and to do the work. I would recommend them to anyone who needed any tree work done. Thank you
